name: ast-layer
description: Deterministic, read-only JS/TS analysis for coding agents, packaged as a Claude Code plugin.
author: Santiago Pacini

scripts.build: esbuild src/main.js --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --target=node18 --outfile=plugin/dist/ast-layer.cjs --log-level=warning --legal-comments=none --metafile=node_modules/.ast-layer-meta.json && node scripts/third-party-licenses.mjs node_modules/.ast-layer-meta.json plugin/dist/THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.txt
